cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.25)
project(sh3_fonts_fixture LANGUAGES CXX)
option(SH3_WITH_HARFBUZZ "Test HarfBuzz as well as FreeType" OFF)

if(NOT SH3_FONT OR NOT EXISTS "${SH3_FONT}")
    message(FATAL_ERROR "Set SH3_FONT to the generated synthetic font")
endif()
if(NOT SH3_PREFIX OR NOT IS_DIRECTORY "${SH3_PREFIX}/lib")
    message(FATAL_ERROR "Set SH3_PREFIX to the explicit private installation")
endif()

if(SH3_FT_BUILD AND SH3_FT_SOURCE)
    set(ft_library "${SH3_FT_BUILD}/libfreetype.dylib")
    set(ft_headers "${SH3_FT_BUILD}/include;${SH3_FT_SOURCE}/include")
else()
    set(ft_library "${SH3_PREFIX}/lib/libfreetype.dylib")
    set(ft_headers "${SH3_PREFIX}/include/freetype2")
endif()
if(NOT EXISTS "${ft_library}")
    message(FATAL_ERROR "FreeType library missing from explicit location")
endif()
add_library(sh3_freetype SHARED IMPORTED)
set_target_properties(sh3_freetype PROPERTIES
    IMPORTED_LOCATION "${ft_library}" INTERFACE_INCLUDE_DIRECTORIES "${ft_headers}")

add_executable(sh3_freetype_fixture freetype.cpp)
target_link_libraries(sh3_freetype_fixture PRIVATE sh3_freetype)
target_compile_features(sh3_freetype_fixture PRIVATE cxx_std_20)
target_compile_options(sh3_freetype_fixture PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -Werror)
enable_testing()
foreach(case IN ITEMS version raster autohint invalid)
    add_test(NAME freetype-${case} COMMAND sh3_freetype_fixture ${case} "${SH3_FONT}")
    set_tests_properties(freetype-${case} PROPERTIES TIMEOUT 15)
endforeach()

if(SH3_WITH_HARFBUZZ)
    if(SH3_HB_BUILD AND SH3_HB_SOURCE)
        set(hb_library "${SH3_HB_BUILD}/libharfbuzz.dylib")
        set(hb_headers "${SH3_HB_BUILD}/src;${SH3_HB_SOURCE}/src")
    else()
        set(hb_library "${SH3_PREFIX}/lib/libharfbuzz.dylib")
        set(hb_headers "${SH3_PREFIX}/include/harfbuzz")
    endif()
    if(NOT EXISTS "${hb_library}")
        message(FATAL_ERROR "HarfBuzz library missing from explicit location")
    endif()
    add_library(sh3_harfbuzz SHARED IMPORTED)
    set_target_properties(sh3_harfbuzz PROPERTIES
        IMPORTED_LOCATION "${hb_library}" INTERFACE_INCLUDE_DIRECTORIES "${hb_headers}")
    add_executable(sh3_harfbuzz_fixture harfbuzz.cpp)
    target_link_libraries(sh3_harfbuzz_fixture PRIVATE sh3_harfbuzz)
    target_compile_features(sh3_harfbuzz_fixture PRIVATE cxx_std_20)
    target_compile_options(sh3_harfbuzz_fixture PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -Werror)
    foreach(case IN ITEMS shape features bounds)
        add_test(NAME harfbuzz-${case} COMMAND sh3_harfbuzz_fixture ${case} "${SH3_FONT}")
        set_tests_properties(harfbuzz-${case} PROPERTIES TIMEOUT 15)
    endforeach()
endif()
